edits.old: After collection creation, collMod can increase granularity or the custom span and rounding values but cannot decrease them. Existing bucket documents are not rewritten when the setting changes; the new span applies to new buckets. (high confidence) (verified as of 2026-10-22)
edits.new: After collection creation, collMod can increase granularity or the custom bucketing values (bucketMaxSpanSeconds and bucketRoundingSeconds) but cannot decrease them. Changing granularity does not change how data is stored across existing buckets. Sources: https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-limitations.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-granularity.md ; https://www.mongodb.com/docs/manual/core/timeseries/timeseries-bucketing.md

edits.old: MongoDB describes granularity as the expected cadence between measurements. Its presets map to bucketRoundingSeconds and bucketMaxSpanSeconds as follows: seconds = 60 and 3,600; minutes = 3,600 and 86,400; hours = 86,400 and 2,592,000. (high confidence)
edits.new: MongoDB describes granularity as the expected cadence between measurements.
